summary: Proposal Phase 2, Task 2e (connector-independent part) — additive column public.quotes.signatory_snapshot jsonb. Stores the proposal's OWN signatory list + signing rule ({ rule: 'all'|'any', signatories: [{ person_id?, contact_id?, ch_officer_id?, name, email, is_primary, required }] }) so that later Companies-House / contact changes never silently mutate an in-flight proposal. ADDITIVE ONLY, safe to apply, with NO live-body dependency: a single ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS. No function is re-issued; no RPC, gate, trigger, RLS policy, or CHECK is touched. Nothing reads the column yet — the acceptance-time flow of this snapshot into engagement_letters / engagement_letter_signatories is Task 2d (connector-blocked). App side: the CreateQuoteDialog Signatories step (ProposalSignatoriesSection.tsx + src/lib/proposal/signatories.ts) writes this snapshot on quote creation.

problem.context: Phase 2 needs the proposal to capture who signs (CH directors / linked individual + manual signatories), one primary contact, an email each, and an all-must-sign (default) / any-one-may-sign rule, stored immutably on the proposal. Task 2e's connector-independent part is the selection UI plus this additive storage column. The acceptance-time creation of engagement_letter_signatories from the snapshot (Task 2d) is deferred and connector-blocked.
